slides.title: A senior messaged you about a role. Now what?
Reply the same day
slides.body: A short thank-you tonight beats a perfect essay next week. Seniors are busy too.

slides.title: Lead with one project, not your whole resume
slides.body: What you built, the stack, and the one part you're proud of. Three lines, done.

slides.title: Keep it in one chat
slides.caption: The role and company sit on top of the chat, so you always know which opening it's about.

slides.title: Offer to walk them through it
slides.body: Repo link, a quick demo, ten minutes on a call. Make it easy for them to say yes.

slides.title: No ghosting, no guessing
slides.body: When the role closes, the chat is archived automatically. You're never left wondering whether to send a fifth follow-up.

slides.title: Save this for placement season
slides.body: Tag your college. 30-day free trial for colleges, no card needed.
